findings.conflict: field is date-only but CR needs a timestamp
findings.spec_constraint: Format is ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD (date only, no time component)
findings.evidence_quote: Data Type & Format: ISO 8601 date, format YYYY-MM-DD.
findings.reasoning: EMIR REFIT captures the occurrence of lifecycle events using the 'Event date' field (Table 2, Item 153). However, the specification restricts the format strictly to an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) without a time component. Therefore, EMIR cannot support reporting an exact date and timestamp format for lifecycle events.
